morning_evening.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
morning_evening.translation: In the Name of Allah, with Whose Name there is protection against every kind of harm in the earth or in the heaven, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
morning_evening.reference: Sunan Abi Dawud 5088, Jami` at-Tirmidhi 3388 (Recite 3 times)

morning_evening.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
morning_evening.translation: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the morning, by Your leave we have reached the evening, by Your leave we live and die, and unto You is the resurrection.

morning_evening.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي
morning_evening.translation: O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family, and my wealth.

morning_evening.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
morning_evening.translation: There is no deity except Allah, alone, without partner. His is the dominion and praise, and He has power over all things.
Glory be to Allah and Praise be to Him.

morning_evening.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
morning_evening.translation: O Ever Living, O Sustainer, by Your Mercy I seek help. Rectify all my affairs, and do not entrust me to myself even for the blink of an eye.

morning_evening.arabic: سَيِّدُ الاِسْتِغْفَارِ : اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ ...
morning_evening.translation: The chief of repentance: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no deity except You...

protection.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
protection.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
protection.reference: Sahih Muslim 2708 (For protection against evil eye, scorpion, etc.)

protection.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ ۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
protection.translation: Sufficient for me is Allah; there is no deity except Him. On Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the mighty Throne.
protection.reference: Quran 9:129 (Recite 7 times for ease of affairs)

protection.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
protection.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, and from being overcome by debt and the domination of men.

protection.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، وَاحْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
protection.translation: O Allah, conceal my faults, calm my fears, protect me from in front, behind, right, left, and above, and I seek refuge in Your Greatness from being swallowed from beneath.

protection.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ... قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ... قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
protection.translation: Recitation of Surah Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, and An-Nas for protection.
protection.reference: Sahih Muslim 814 (Recite 3 times each morning, evening, and before sleep)

study_success.translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

study_success.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
study_success.translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.

study_success.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا
study_success.translation: O Allah, benefit me with what You have taught me, teach me what will benefit me, and increase me in knowledge.

prophets_duas.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
prophets_duas.translation: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
prophets_duas.reference: Quran 21:87 (Dua of Prophet Yunus عليه السلام)

prophets_duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
prophets_duas.translation: My Lord, grant me from Yourself good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.
prophets_duas.reference: Quran 3:38 (Dua of Prophet Zakariyya عليه السلام)

prophets_duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
prophets_duas.translation: Our Lord, grant us in this world [that which is] good and in the Hereafter [that which is] good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
prophets_duas.reference: Quran 2:201 (A comprehensive Dua often recited by the Prophet ﷺ)

prophets_duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَنْ دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا
prophets_duas.translation: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer.
prophets_duas.reference: Quran 71:28 (Dua of Prophet Nuh عليه السلام)

prophets_duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
prophets_duas.translation: My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
prophets_duas.reference: Quran 26:83 (Dua of Prophet Ibrahim عليه السلام)

travel.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
travel.translation: Glory be to Him Who has subjected this to us, for we could not have done so ourselves. And surely to our Lord we will return.

travel.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ
travel.translation: O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the Guardian over the family.

travel.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ
travel.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no power and no strength except with Allah.
travel.reference: Jami` at-Tirmidhi 3426 (Recite upon leaving the house)

sleep_waking.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

sleep_waking.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
sleep_waking.translation: All praise is for Allah, who gave us life after causing us to die, and unto Him is the resurrection.

sleep_waking.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
sleep_waking.translation: O Allah, save me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your slaves.
sleep_waking.reference: Sunan Abi Dawud 5045 (Recite 3 times before sleeping)

food_drink.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
food_drink.translation: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might nor power from myself.
food_drink.reference: Sunan Abi Dawud 4023 (After finishing the meal)

food_drink.translation: In the name of Allah, its beginning and its end.
food_drink.reference: Sunan Abi Dawud 3767 (If you forget Bismillah at the start)

wudu_salah.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
wudu_salah.translation: I bear witness that there is no deity except Allah alone, with no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger.

wudu_salah.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
wudu_salah.translation: O Allah, make me among those who turn to You in repentance, and make me among those who are purified.
Glorified is my Lord, the Great.
Glorified is my Lord, the Most High.

visiting_sick.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
visiting_sick.translation: No harm will come, it is a purification, if Allah wills.

visiting_sick.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ، رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
visiting_sick.translation: I ask Allah, the Mighty, the Lord of the Mighty Throne, to cure you.
